headline: Executive order titled to provide emergency tax relief on diesel fuel; details were not available.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with lowering or easing taxes on diesel fuel because of an emergency. No summary was provided, so the exact steps it takes, how much relief it offers, and how long it lasts are not known. Federal fuel tax rates are generally set by Congress, so the order's real effect depends on details not included here.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses that buy diesel fuel
who_it_affects.how: They may see lower diesel tax costs, depending on what the order actually does.
